task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Take the printed label sauce can with the left arm, place it near the cooking kitchenpot with sturdy handles
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架用左臂拿起印刷标签酱罐，将其放置在带有坚固手柄的烹饪厨房锅附近
